artifact_observations.location: Side of the iron body, below the green window

The internal components visible through the green plastic lack logical mechanical definition, appearing as vague shapes rather than distinct water tanks or wiring.

artifact_observations.location: Base of the power cord connection
artifact_observations.reasoning: The transition where the cord enters the body is slightly soft and lacks a distinct strain relief boot, blending slightly into the casing.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific category of the appliance and rule out misclassification as similar household objects.
To analyze the illegible text on the side of the iron, which is a common artifact in AI generation.
To check for boundary bleeding between the cord and the body, and ensure the handle loop is topologically sound.

focus_areas: Legibility and structure of printed text on the casing
Logical consistency of internal components visible through translucent plastic
Sharpness of the boundary between the power cord and the main body
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'text_gibberish' artifact. AI models often fail to render crisp product labels. Also, evaluate if the translucent green parts show physically plausible internal structures (water tank levels/mechanisms) or just amorphous blobs.
